name: University of East Anglia
description: At UEA, we welcome passionate and innovative researchers who see the value in cross-disciplinary work. We’re a research-intensive university with the networks, resources and vision to match your research ambitions. You’ll find UEA to be a supportive institution that truly values its academic research community. As you develop your career and life at UEA, you’ll find that Norwich and the surrounding area are as affordable as they are beautiful. Timestamps Updated
